chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 310: The Hunters Become the Hunted – Counter-Ambush
chapter_meta_description: Han Li pursues the Young Prince to a ruined temple, only to find a Foundation Establishment enforcer and a squad of Black Fiend disciples waiting for him. A trap flips the tables.
og_description: Foundation Establishment cultivator appears behind Han Li as the Young Prince springs his trap. A cold reversal of fortune.
twitter_title: Ambush Turned: Han Li Faces a Foundation Enemy
twitter_description: The Young Prince outwits the hunting party and reveals a blood-robed Foundation cultivator as his backup. The tables turn hard.

lore_anchors.definition: A simple earth-attribute defensive formation that projects a yellow light barrier; can be broken by overwhelming it with raw magical power.
A basic perception spell that allows a cultivator to see spiritual energy flows and detect formations or hidden auras.
The second major cultivation realm, after Qi Condensation; a cultivator at this level has built a stable internal foundation and vastly superior power reserves compared to lower stages.
The first realm of cultivation, where a practitioner gathers and refines spiritual energy in their body. Cultivators at this level are considered low-level in the sect hierarchy.
A speed-focused flying artifact refined from Ink Flood Dragon fin and tail; extremely fast but lacks defensive capabilities and passenger capacity.
A pair of high-grade magical tools that can expand to the size of a zhang and deliver powerful crushing blows.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn’t Han Li just leave when he saw the Young Prince?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li needed to confirm the target and learn his affiliations. Letting him escape without tracking him would lose critical intelligence.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How did Han Li break the formation so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used multiple puppet beams and the Black Dragon Harpoons simultaneously, overpowering the formation’s energy capacity with brute force, which is a typical Foundation Establishment tactic.
A Foundation Establishment cultivator working for the Black Fiend Sect, likely dispatched to eliminate Han Li and his group after the Young Prince reported the ambush.
